title: alchemilla arvensis var. floribunda
intro: Alchemilla arvensis var. floribunda, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its rosettes of serrated leaves and delicate white flowers. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla arvensis var. floribunda include astringent and hemostatic effects, making it useful in treating bleeding and diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
